* **[GHSA-h2v8-394m-p7vv](https://github.com/rustls/rustls/security/advisories/GHSA-h2v8-394m-p7vv)**: The built-in (but disabled by default) Brotli certificate decompression can allocate an attacker-controlled amount of memory up to 1 GiB before authentication *

* **[GHSA-c8m5-c952-6cm4](https://github.com/rustls/rustls/security/advisories/GHSA-c8m5-c952-6cm4)**: `Debug` impls for `Tls12ClientSessionValue` and `Tls13ClientSessionValue` include secret data *

* **[GHSA-w44r-93j7-qv28](https://github.com/rustls/rustls/security/advisories/GHSA-w44r-93j7-qv28)**: An unauthenticated ServerHello poisons the per-name key-exchange hints, so later ClientHellos carry only a classical X25519 share. Thank you to @Adam010341 .

* **[GHSA-vp88-798v-h67f](https://github.com/rustls/rustls/security/advisories/GHSA-vp88-798v-h67f)**: In rustls 0.23.44 and 0.23.45, application data that a client buffers before the handshake completes is sent to the server even when the server rejects Encrypted Client Hello (ECH). Thank you to @ramonmrc18.

## Other fixes taken from main:

- server: reject non-empty certificate_request_context in https://github.com/rustls/rustls/pull/3294 **
- reject protected change_cipher_spec records in https://github.com/rustls/rustls/pull/3295 **
- brotli: reject large-window streams in https://github.com/rustls/rustls/pull/3297 *
- Avoiding printing secrets in session types in https://github.com/rustls/rustls/pull/3299 *
- client: fail on ECH rejection before encrypting application data in https://github.com/rustls/rustls/pull/3300 *
- server: only allow early data for first PSK in https://github.com/rustls/rustls/pull/3312 *
- compress: reject trailing input in zlib and brotli decompressors in https://github.com/rustls/rustls/pull/3318 **
- ech: hold the server to its hello retry request decision in https://github.com/rustls/rustls/pull/3325 **
- conn: be more careful about confidentiality limits with 1.2 in https://github.com/rustls/rustls/pull/3332 *
- Fixes related to I/O issues in https://github.com/rustls/rustls/pull/3333 *
- Advance the HPKE sequence only after open succeeds in https://github.com/rustls/rustls/pull/3340 *
- Timely 1.3 key updates in https://github.com/rustls/rustls/pull/3342 *

\* Thanks to OpenAI <OutboundDisclosures@openai.com> for submitting 13 findings to us, whose fixes are included in this release.
\** Thanks to @Mounika2456 for their continued contribution of hardening and compliance fixes

## What's Changed
* [0.23] bogo: avoid flicker on error handling with an alert by @ctz in https://github.com/rustls/rustls/pull/3339
* [0.23] Retain up to the requested LimitedCache capacity by @6d7770 in https://github.com/rustls/rustls/pull/3337
* Prepare 0.23.46 by @djc in https://github.com/rustls/rustls/pull/3354
* [0.23] Delay saving KX hint until handshake confirmation by @ctz in https://github.com/rustls/rustls/pull/3355

fix**: TLS 1.3 handshake messages incorrectly accepted across encryption level boundaries

Rustls accepted TLS 1.3 handshake messages sent at the wrong encryption level when they followed a key-changing message in the same record. The handshake transcript is still authenticated, so a network-position attacker cannot use this to alter or complete a handshake; the practical effect is that a peer could send handshake messages that should be encrypted in plaintext without rustls rejecting the connection.

This issue is tracked as [GHSA-2mjx-qc3c-rqvc](https://github.com/rustls/rustls/security/advisories/GHSA-2mjx-qc3c-rqvc). This issue affects rustls versions 0.23.13 through 0.23.44 inclusive.

Note that this is functionally the same bug as [GO-2026-4340](https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-4340).

## What's Changed
* 0.23.45: Ensure handshake "alignment" check covers previously-received messages by @ctz in https://github.com/rustls/rustls/pull/3265
* Further 0.23 backports by @ctz in https://github.com/rustls/rustls/pull/3268 -- this incorporates
  - #3245 
  - #3259
  - #3260
  - #3267
